research_rationale:
EO 12546 (Presidential Commission on the Space Shuttle Challenger Accident), signed 1986-02-03. The order establishes the Presidential Commission on the Space Shuttle Challenger Accident (Section 1), its function of investigating the accident and recommending corrective action (Section 2, with the final report due within one hundred and twenty days of the order), administration (Section 3) and general provisions (Section 4). Section 4(b) ends the Commission 60 days after it submits its final report, which is report-relative and not a dated end. First end: Section 3(h) of EO 12610 (Continuance of Certain Federal Advisory Committees, signed 1987-09-30, 52 FR 36901-36902) names Executive Order No. 12546 among the orders revoked, and Section 5 makes that order effective September 30, 1987, so the revocation took effect on 1987-09-30. The same section describes the listed orders as ones that established committees which have terminated or whose work is completed; that recital is disclosed as context and as a possible earlier cessation, but it gives no date and is not an end.
